title: dryopteris filix-mas subsp. fibrillosa
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. fibrillosa, commonly known as the Rough Buckler Fern, is a subspecies of the Male Fern plant. It is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family, characterized by its fern-like leaves. The Rough Buckler Fern has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
